findings.claim: The large fused-checkpoint text-composition losses occurred during the fixed workflow-training stage; initial merge inability alone cannot explain the final scores.
findings.evidence: Dice51/64 to4/64 with47lost and0gained; arithmetic50/64 to1/64 with49lost and0gained. Both familiar workflows remain64/64. Dice text primitives remain64/64; arithmetic replace falls16/16 to0/16.
findings.program_identity: On keep-replace-join, Dice had20/32 correct and arithmetic18/32; afterward all32 outputs use the familiar TRAIN keep-lower-join plan. On lower-keep-replace, Dice31/32 to4/32 and arithmetic32/32 to1/32; the operation sequence is correct but failed outputs use uppercase ALERT after lowercasing, yielding empty state.
findings.fresh_diagnostic_confirmation: Dice10/16 to0/16, arithmetic9/16 to0/16. Both now emit keep-lower-join on all8 first-pattern inputs; all8 second-pattern inputs have wrong arguments.
findings.causal_boundary: Observed losses after128updates are established. Training-template interference is a behavioral interpretation; which training tokens, gradients or internal circuits cause it is not isolated.

findings.claim: Nearly unchanged fusion averages conceal a copy/move switch; relevant-history composition loss is separately visible despite retained primitives.
findings.evidence: Dice32/64 to27/64 and arithmetic32/64 to31/64 retain0previously correct novel answers. Both lose all32 move-write-delete answers and gain27/31 write-copy-delete answers. Both primitive totals remain48/64 while copy0/16 to16/16 and move16/16 to0/16. Relevant60/64 to32/64 loses28answers while all64file primitives remaincorrect.
findings.program_identity: Initial merges substitute move for copy in write-copy-delete, leading to MISSING_PATH when deleting the now-moved source. After training they repair copy but substitute copy for move in move-write-delete, incorrectly retaining the original source. Relevant-history training changes write-copy-delete into write-move-delete.
findings.fresh_diagnostic_confirmation: Dice8/16 to6/16 with0retained; arithmetic8/16 to8/16 with0retained; relevant16/16 to8/16. The same operation substitutions recur on the fresh scenes.
findings.causal_boundary: Initial copy-binding failure and subsequent loss of move behavior are distinct. The relevant-history composition loss cannot be explained by inability to emit isolated copy/move calls.

limitations: Posthoc diagnosis of failures already observed on original TEST; no new confirmatory held-out claim.
Fresh diagnostic scenes preserve original request templates, operation parameters and task mappings; sixteen inputs per panel are diagnostic replication, not a broad benchmark.
One optimization seed. Four streams jointly change task family, order, aliases and scene seed; these effects are not independently identified.
Explicit three-step requests test composition of known sandbox calls, not autonomous subgoal discovery.
Argument schemas often disclose operation identity; copy/move share schemas but other operations may be inferred from structure.

Original replay labels describe prior primitive history. All original workflow arms trained512new examples without workflow-stage replay; the new hybrid explicitly introduces rehearsal during workflow updates.
No general superiority of fusion over replay or of relevant history over irrelevant history is established.
No TEST-based recipe, rank, budget, threshold or checkpoint changes were made.
